description: Ability seed secured by I-1 (2026-08-14 correction): the mean ability of prerequisites includes ALL states in I-1's secured set (mastered, needs_review, relearning), NOT just the literal string 'mastered'. Unsecured states (locked, available, in_progress, or unattempted) are excluded. A prerequisite in 'relearning' contributes its evidenced ability_elo.

cases.description: Hard prerequisites in mixed states: relearning (1500), needs_review (1400), in_progress (1100)
cases.notes: Secured statuses under I-1 are {mastered, needs_review, relearning}. Both INTEGERS (relearning) and FRACTIONS (needs_review) count: (1500 + 1400) / 2 = 1450. DECIMALS is in_progress (unsecured) and is excluded.
A prerequisite in relearning carries genuine historical evidence and seeds the next node at 1380 rather than falling back to 1200.

cases.description: Hard prerequisites only in unsecured states (available, in_progress, locked)
cases.notes: No hard prerequisites are secured under I-1, so fallback is 1200.
